caption: The drawing depicts an old-fashioned cast iron stove set within a rectangular brick enclosure. The stove features ornate detailing and several compartments, including a lower oven door that is ajar, upper storage cupboards, and decorative molding along the top edge. On the stove’s cooking surface, there are three items: a small pan with a handle, a shallow round dish, and a pot with a lid and a handle. The cast iron components are predominantly dark gray or black, contrasting with the reddish-brown color of the surrounding bricks. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Stove
